description_en: Asynchronously creates a pipeline or unstructured workflow
description_zh: 异步创建管道/非结构化工作流
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-pipeline-by-async --op-tenant-id 30001011 --context ProjectId=123 Env=DEV --create-command '{"ScheduleConfig":"{\"cronExpression\":\"0 0 0 * * ?\"}","PipelineConfig":{"Steps":[{"PluginConfig":"{}","StepType":"input","StepName":"mysql_reader","Key":"mysqlinput"}],"Hops":[{"Target":"odps_writer","Source":"mysql_reader"}]},"NodeInfo":{"NodeName":"test"}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipelineByAsync

fields.help_en: The current operation environment. Valid values: DEV: development environment. PROD: production environment. For workflows, only PROD is currently supported
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境 env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境（对于工作流，目前仅支持 PROD）
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: The ID of the project to which the integration pipeline or workflow task belongs
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流任务所属项目 ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en: The comment
fields.help_zh: 备注
fields.name: comment

fields.help_en: The integration pipeline configuration mode. Valid values: PIPELINE: pipeline mode (default). JSON: script mode. Ignore this parameter for workflows
fields.help_zh: 集成管道配置模式：PIPELINE-表示管道模式（默认），JSON-表示脚本模式。 如果为工作流，则无需关注
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The node directory of the integration pipeline task. Default value: root directory. The directory must exist. If it does not exist, call the relevant API operation to create a directory of the offlinePipeline type
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务节点目录（默认为根目录），该目录必须存在，如若不存在，则需要调用相关接口创建类型为offlinePipeline的目录
fields.name: directory

fields.help_en: The ID of the pipeline file. Leave this parameter empty when creating a task for the first time. When updating a pipeline task, you must configure at least one of the following parameters: pipelineId, fileId, and nodeId
fields.help_zh: 管道文件ID，首次创建为空，更新管道任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the schedule node for the pipeline task. Leave this parameter empty when creating a task for the first time. When updating a pipeline task, you must configure at least one of the following parameters: pipelineId, fileId, and nodeId
fields.help_zh: 管道任务调度节点ID，首次创建为空，更新管道任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en: The name of the integration pipeline task
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务名称
fields.name: node_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the pipeline task. Leave this parameter empty when creating a task for the first time. When updating a pipeline task, you must configure at least one of the following parameters: pipelineId, fileId, and nodeId
fields.help_zh: 管道任务ID，首次创建为空，更新管道任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: The basic information of the integration pipeline task
fields.help_zh: 集成管道任务基本信息
fields.name: node_info

fields.help_en: For conditional distribution components, set this parameter to true if the downstream connection condition is true. Otherwise, set it to false. Ignore this parameter for workflow tasks
fields.help_zh: 针对条件分发组件，连接下游条件为 true 时设置为 true，否则设置为 false。 如果为工作流任务，则无需关注
fields.name: send_to

fields.help_en: The name of the input step, which corresponds to Steps[*].StepName
fields.help_zh: 输入步骤名称，即Steps[*].StepName
fields.name: source

fields.help_en: The name of the output step, which corresponds to Steps[*].StepName
fields.help_zh: 输出步骤名称，即Steps[*].StepName
fields.name: target

fields.help_en: The directed acyclic graph (DAG) link configuration that describes the connection relationships among all components
fields.help_zh: DAG有向无环图链接配置：描述所有组件的连接关系
fields.name: hops

fields.help_en: The data distribution method when the current component has multiple downstream components. Valid values: true: distributes data from the current component to all downstream components in turn. For example, if the current component has 100 data records and two downstream components, each downstream component receives 50 data records. Default value: true. false: sends all data from the current component to all downstream components. For example, if the current component has 100 data records and two downstream components, both downstream components receive all 100 data records. Ignore this parameter for workflow tasks
fields.help_zh: 用于表示当前组件有多个下游组件时当前组件数据的分发方式： true-表示当前组件的数据轮流发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有 100 条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游各有 50 条数据，默认为 true， false-表示当前组件的数据全量发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有 100 条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游都有 100 条数据。 如果为工作流任务，则无需关注此值
fields.name: is_distribute

fields.help_en: The plugin ID. Each plugin or operator has a unique identifier. Refer to the stepKey field in the com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig utility class. Developers must inherit this component or operator configuration class to implement the corresponding configuration. The structure of each component or operator configuration must be identical to the configuration structure created on the Dataphin page
fields.help_zh: 插件 ID，每个插件/算子都有唯一的标志，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与 Dataphin 页面创建的配置结构相同
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The specific component configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the toJsonString method of the relevant subclasses of com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig (for workflow operators, use com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig). Developers must inherit this component or operator configuration class to implement the corresponding configuration. The structure of each component or operator configuration must be identical to the task configuration structure created on the Dataphin page
fields.help_zh: 具体组件配置，格式为 JSON 字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig（工作流算子则为 com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig）相关子类的 toJsonString 方法。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与 Dataphin 页面创建的任务配置结构相同
fields.name: plugin_config

fields.help_en: The step name. Step names must be unique within the same pipeline task
fields.help_zh: 步骤名称，在同一个管道任务所有步骤名称不能重复
fields.name: step_name

fields.help_en: The component type. Valid values: input: input component. output: output component. transfrom: transform component. process: flow control component. For workflow tasks, this indicates the operator type, such as image for images and text for text. Refer to the stepType field in the com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig utility class. Developers must inherit this component or operator configuration class to implement the corresponding configuration. The structure of each component or operator configuration must be identical to the configuration structure created on the Dataphin page
fields.help_zh: 组件类型：input-表示输入组件，output-表示输出组件，transfrom-表示转换组件，process-表示流程控制组件，对于工作流任务则表示算子类型，例如：image-图片，text-文本。参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与 Dataphin 页面创建的配置结构相同
fields.name: step_type

fields.help_en: The component or operator configurations, including the detailed configurations of all used components or operators
fields.help_zh: 组件/算子配置：包含所有用到的组件/算子详细配置
fields.name: steps

fields.help_en: The integration pipeline component or workflow operator configuration
fields.help_zh: 集成管道组件/工作流算子配置
fields.name: pipeline_config

fields.help_en: The integration pipeline configuration in JSON string format for script mode. Workflow tasks do not support script mode
fields.help_zh: 脚本模式下：集成管道配置（json 字符串格式）。 工作流任务不支持脚本模式
fields.name: pipeline_json

fields.help_en: The task type. Valid values: 0: offline integration (default). 1: real-time integration. 14: offline workflow task. 15: real-time workflow
fields.help_zh: 任务类型：0-表示离线集成（默认），1-表示实时集成，14-表示离线工作流任务，15-表示实时工作流
fields.name: pipeline_type

fields.help_en: The schedule configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the toJsonString method in the com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig utility class
fields.help_zh: 调度配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString方法
fields.name: schedule_config

fields.help_en: The channel configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the toJsonString method in the com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting utility class
fields.help_zh: 通道配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString方法
fields.name: settings

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to submit the task. By default, the task is submitted
fields.help_zh: 是否提交，默认提交
fields.name: submit

parameters.help_en: The configuration for creating a pipeline or workflow task
parameters.help_zh: 创建管道/工作流任务配置
parameters.name: create_command

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who performs the operation
parameters.name: op_user_id

Data.description_en: The ID used to query the asynchronous execution status

Message.description_en: The details of the backend exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
